📺 Borgia (2011–2014)

Borgia follows the rise of the powerful and controversial Borgia family during the Italian Renaissance, a time when religion, politics, and personal ambition shaped the future of Europe. At the center of the story is Rodrigo Borgia, a calculating cardinal who becomes Pope Alexander VI and uses his influence to strengthen his family’s position within the Catholic Church. Alongside his ambitious children Cesare, Juan, and Lucrezia, Rodrigo becomes involved in dangerous political alliances, secret relationships, betrayals, and violent struggles for power. As rival families and powerful rulers challenge their authority, the Borgias must navigate a world where loyalty is uncertain and every decision carries serious consequences. Filled with historical intrigue, forbidden romance, shocking betrayals, and intense family conflicts, the series explores ambition, corruption, loyalty, and the dangerous pursuit of power.

🎭 Genre: Historical Drama • Crime • Political Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 52 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Tom Fontana

📺 Seasons: 3

📚 Based On: The historical Borgia family during the Italian Renaissance.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Amazon Prime Video and Apple TV for current streaming or purchase availability in the United States.

source_details.synopsis: Borgia is a historical drama television series created by Tom Fontana for Canal+, ZDF, ORF, and Sky Italia. The show recounts the Borgia family's rise to power and subsequent domination of the Papal States during the Renaissance. Borgia debuted in Italy on Sky Cinema 1 on 10 July 2011. It was since renewed for a second season, which premiered in France on Canal+ on 18 March 2013. A third and final season premiered in France on Canal+ on 15 September 2014. The series finale aired in France on Canal+ on 27 October 2014 as the 38th episode overall.
